name: paperclip
description_en: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
readme_excerpt: Quickstart · Docs · GitHub · Discord · Twitter · Website Paperclip is the app people use to manage AI agents for work. Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents. If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company. Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Bring your own agents, assign goals, and track work and costs from one dashboard. It looks like a task manager. Under the hood: org charts, b…
